name: glb-designer-stage10c
description: Asset Studio Iteration 6 Stage 10c — Chesterfield (diamond) tufting in the GLB Asset Designer (Pro, glbDesigner on). Insert the Bench template (its upholstered top ships plumped + tufted, a rectangular grid), give the seat cushion a velvet sheen, then switch the Tufting Pattern to Diamond and turn Stitch lines ON — the classic chesterfield read: an offset button lattice with diagonal stitch lines running through the dimple valleys. Assert the offset lattice + tagged stitch decals generated, toggle back to Grid (assert the decals regenerate), flip back to Diamond, and Save — asserting the persisted def's assetSpec is a v>=13 envelope (asserted loosely so a concurrent envelope bump can't false-fail) embedding parts[].tuft.pattern='diamond' + stitches + the tagged stitch decals. Run with SHOT_GPU=1 (the velvet sheen + stitch lines read best on a real GPU).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: velvet-cushion
steps.comment: Give the Seat cushion a velvet sheen (KHR_materials_sheen) so the diamond dimples + stitch lines catch light — the chesterfield read. Driven through the designer setSpec seam (deterministic, no fragile material-UI walk).
steps.eval: (function(){ const api = window.__glbDesigner; const s = api.getSpec(); const parts = s.parts.map(p => p.name === 'Seat cushion' ? { ...p, color: '#5b2733', sheen: 0.9, sheenColor: '#8a4a56', sheenRoughness: 0.65, roughness: 0.85, metalness: 0 } : p); api.setSpec({ ...s, parts }); })()

steps.name: home-view
steps.eval: (function(){ const b = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Home view"]'); if (b) b.click(); })()

steps.name: select-cushion
steps.comment: Select the bench's Seat cushion so the Tufting controls appear (expand the Bench group first if collapsed).
steps.eval: (function(){ const findRow = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')].find(n => (n.textContent||'').trim() === 'Seat cushion'); let nm = findRow(); if (!nm) { const exp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Expand Bench"]'); if (exp) exp.click(); nm = findRow(); } if (!nm) throw new Error('Seat cushion layer row not found'); const row = nm.closest('.lyr-row'); row.scrollIntoView(); row.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-tuft-controls
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Tufting rows"]')) throw new Error('Tufting rows slider missing — the cushion is not selected or not tuftable'); if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer div[role="radiogroup"][aria-label="Tufting pattern"]')) throw new Error('Tufting pattern segmented missing'); if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Tufting stitches"]')) throw new Error('Tufting stitches toggle missing'); })()

steps.name: shot-grid-baseline
steps.comment: The 7c reference: the bench's rectangular button grid, for comparison against the diamond frame.

steps.name: select-diamond
steps.comment: Click the Diamond segment of the Tufting Pattern control — the offset-row lattice.
steps.eval: (function(){ const grp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer div[role="radiogroup"][aria-label="Tufting pattern"]'); if (!grp) throw new Error('pattern segmented not found'); const btn = [...grp.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => (b.textContent||'').trim() === 'Diamond'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Diamond segment not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: enable-stitches
steps.comment: Turn Stitch lines ON — diagonal stitches between adjacent buttons.
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Tufting stitches"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('stitches toggle not found'); if (btn.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true') btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-diamond-stitches
steps.comment: The cushion carries a diamond tuft grid with stitches ON, its buttons form an offset lattice (odd rows shifted vs even rows) and tagged stitch decals were generated.
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const c = s.parts.find(p => p.name === 'Seat cushion'); if (!c || !c.tuft) throw new Error('cushion has no tuft grid'); if (c.tuft.pattern !== 'diamond') throw new Error('pattern is not diamond: ' + c.tuft.pattern); if (c.tuft.stitches !== true) throw new Error('stitches not enabled'); const dec = (s.decals||[]).filter(d => d.tuft && d.partId === c.id); const buttons = dec.filter(d => d.kind === 'button'); const lines = dec.filter(d => d.kind === 'stitch'); if (buttons.length !== c.tuft.rows * c.tuft.cols) throw new Error('button count ' + buttons.length + ' != ' + (c.tuft.rows*c.tuft.cols)); if (lines.length === 0) throw new Error('no stitch decals generated'); if (!lines.every(d => typeof d.rotation === 'number')) throw new Error('stitch decals missing a rotation angle'); window.__diamondDecalIds = dec.map(d => d.id); })()

steps.name: shot-chesterfield
steps.comment: THE frame this stage exists for: the velvet seat cushion with DIAMOND tufting + stitch lines — an offset button lattice with visible diagonal stitch lines running through the dimple valleys (the chesterfield read). Compare against 01-grid-baseline.

steps.name: toggle-back-to-grid
steps.comment: Switch the pattern back to Grid — the tagged decals must regenerate (fresh ids, orthogonal stitches).
steps.eval: (function(){ const grp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer div[role="radiogroup"][aria-label="Tufting pattern"]'); const btn = [...grp.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => (b.textContent||'').trim() === 'Grid'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Grid segment not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-grid-regen
steps.comment: Back on the grid: the pattern flipped off diamond and the tuft decals were fully replaced (no id survives the pattern change).
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const c = s.parts.find(p => p.name === 'Seat cushion'); if (c.tuft.pattern === 'diamond') throw new Error('pattern did not leave diamond'); const dec = (s.decals||[]).filter(d => d.tuft && d.partId === c.id); const before = new Set(window.__diamondDecalIds || []); if (dec.some(d => before.has(d.id))) throw new Error('old diamond decals were not replaced'); if (dec.filter(d => d.kind === 'stitch').length === 0) throw new Error('grid stitches missing (stitches should stay on)'); })()

steps.name: restore-diamond
steps.comment: Flip back to Diamond so the saved asset is the chesterfield showcase.
steps.eval: (function(){ const grp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer div[role="radiogroup"][aria-label="Tufting pattern"]'); const btn = [...grp.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => (b.textContent||'').trim() === 'Diamond'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'Stage10c Chesterfield'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-saved-chesterfield
steps.comment: End-to-end proof: the saved assetSpec is a v>=13 envelope (loose — a concurrent envelope bump must not false-fail) embedding parts[].tuft.pattern='diamond' + stitches + the tagged stitch decals — the chesterfield round-trips as an editable spec.

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__glbBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Stage10c Chesterfield' && typeof d.assetSpec === 'string' && (() => { try { const env = JSON.parse(d.assetSpec); if (typeof env.v !== 'number' || env.v < 13) return false; const s = env.payload; const c = s.parts.find(p => p.name === 'Seat cushion'); if (!c || !c.tuft || c.tuft.pattern !== 'diamond' || c.tuft.stitches !== true) return false; const lines = (s.decals||[]).filter(x => x.tuft && x.kind === 'stitch'); const buttons = (s.decals||[]).filter(x => x.tuft && x.kind === 'button'); return lines.length > 0 && buttons.length === c.tuft.rows * c.tuft.cols; } catch { return false } })())

steps.failMessage: saved assetSpec should embed parts[].tuft.pattern='diamond' + stitches + tagged stitch decals at a v>=13 envelope
